FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Boilers Sectional Committee had been approved by the Heavy Mechanical Engineering Division Council. The information given by a purchaser according to this data sheet will enable a manufacturer or supplier to assess the exact requirements of the purchaser and recommend to him the most suitable type of equipment.
